server.sql: SELECT VERSION() version, DATABASE() db, UTC_TIMESTAMP() utc_now, @@session.time_zone session_timezone, @@global.time_zone global_timezone, @@read_only server_readonly

tables.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,TABLE_ROWS,DATA_LENGTH,INDEX_LENGTH,DATA_FREE,TABLE_COLLATION FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' ORDER BY DATA_LENGTH DESC

columns.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,COLUMN_DEFAULT,EXTRA FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

indexes.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,SUB_PART,INDEX_TYPE,IS_VISIBLE FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX

foreign_keys.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION

variables.sql: SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('max_connections','innodb_buffer_pool_size','slow_query_log','long_query_time','performance_schema','log_bin','binlog_expire_logs_seconds','innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit','sync_binlog','require_secure_transport','wait_timeout')

status.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Uptime','Threads_connected','Threads_running','Max_used_connections','Slow_queries','Connections','Aborted_connects','Innodb_buffer_pool_reads','Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests','Created_tmp_disk_tables','Created_tmp_tables','Innodb_row_lock_waits','Innodb_row_lock_time','Questions')

connections.sql: SELECT COMMAND,STATE,COUNT(*) connections,MAX(TIME) max_seconds FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE DB=DATABASE() GROUP BY COMMAND,STATE

transactions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) active_transactions,MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,trx_started,NOW())) oldest_seconds,SUM(trx_rows_locked) rows_locked FROM information_schema.INNODB_TRX

statement_digest.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT,COUNT_STAR,ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000,3) total_seconds,ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000,3) avg_ms,MAX_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000 max_ms,SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED,SUM_ROWS_SENT,SUM_NO_INDEX_USED,SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES,FIRST_SEEN,LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME=DATABASE() AND DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 20

statement_errors.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT,COUNT_STAR,SUM_ERRORS,SUM_WARNINGS,FIRST_SEEN,LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME=DATABASE() AND SUM_ERRORS>0 ORDER BY SUM_ERRORS DESC LIMIT 12
